messages:
Rae: ran into an oddity on canary with shared-slab: tenant small-101 got tokens from tenant small-202 and started serving stale prefix entries. short repro below.
Diego: can you paste logs?
Rae: logs: 
```
2026-03-05T14:23:01Z INFO evict: tenant=small-202 demote=2 -> slab=5
2026-03-05T14:23:02Z INFO handback: shard=5 from=small-202 -> to=small-101 tokens=2 gen=81
2026-03-05T14:23:18Z ERROR readpath: tenant=small-101 stale-prefix key=0x44 gen=81
```
Anika: ohhh we still treat handback credits as opaque. when the slab is shared across tenants the receiver must validate that owner generation is safe.
Will: proposal: include owner_tenant + owner_gen on handback RPC, and receiver consults lease.safe_gen(owner_tenant). accept if owner_gen <= safe_gen OR tokens <= FASTPATH_SMALL. otherwise reject and trigger local cold-fill.
Rae: pseudocode: 
```
bool accept_handback(h) {
  if (h.owner_tenant == my_tenant) return true;
  if (h.owner_gen <= lease.safe_gen(h.owner_tenant)) return true;
  if (h.tokens <= 1) return true; // fastpath tiny moves
  return false; // force prefill
}
```
Diego: we'll need cursor guards too: cursors must record expected_prefix_gen and fail resume if gen mismatch. otherwise long-lived cursors could reference stale layout.
Anika: also add metrics: handback.accepted, handback.rejected{reason=gen_mismatch,src,dst}, readpath.stale. ops can use these to calibrate FASTPATH thresholds.
Will: infra estimate: tag + basic accept check ~1 day; lease.safe_gen plumbing + tests ~3 days. chaos test to flip owners rapidly is required.
Rae: ops: temp mitigation is a cluster-level knob to disable shared-slab per-tenant for safety during rollout.
ops-bot: Automated: created ticket INF-9999 (handback validation + cursor gen-safety) assigned to Diego, Anika.
